text: Binary flag (1/0) from the argument column only (the OP's own text): 1 if it contains an explicit first-person narrative of something that actually happened to or was done/lived by the OP (a specific event, episode, or period of their life). 0 if there is no such account: abstract reasoning, general claims, hypotheticals, invented scenarios, others' experiences, or merely stating an opinion or identity. Quoted or external text counts only if the OP adopts it as their own experience. Marked edits count as current text, but OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred are excluded and never count as evidence; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither positive nor excluded. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Missing or malformed argument returns null.
